scope: Standalone native finale timeline and authored-ending selection, outside Load/Run until presentation and host continuation are connected.
coverage: 120 scenarios: four episodic endpoints and six commercial text/cast boundaries, each with text lengths0/1/400 and four input patterns.
180,000 steps compare stage, tic, done state, art/cast/next transition requests, episode-three music-start request timing and text reveal count with the released C routines.

The C oracle compiles unchanged F_StartFinale and F_Ticker bodies; cast animation/music callbacks are observation stubs. Character-delay arithmetic is extracted from F_TextWrite and capped at the terminating zero byte.
Held, boundary and late presses cover the strictly-greater-than50 commercial skip rule. Episode endings ignore skip buttons and wait for three tics per byte plus250 tics.
64 invalid endpoint selections reject before modifying the previous timeline; missing authored text is an empty string, and temporary fixture memory is released.
limits: No cast state animation, finale image/font rasterization, music playback or gameplay-host integration is qualified by this fixture.
Original C cast starts and art/music requests are signals here; this does not claim that the corresponding audio or images have been played.
subsequentHostQualification: finale-play-evidence.json records the later Load/Run connection; this file retains its original component proof inputs.
